_comment: CDP end-to-end tier of the perf ratchet (bin/webperf-gate.ts). The BULK of perf coverage is chrome-free and sub-1ms (bin/bench-gate.ts: db/read/render/pure-fn micro-benches); this tier keeps only load_to_interactive — a real cold load through paint+network, which a browser uniquely reveals. It is a COARSE backstop for big load regressions (the 14s-load / 22s-board class), and nothing finer: the number is wall-clock on a SHARED box whose load swings ~4x within an hour, so the band is sized from that machine variance (measured 2026-09-05: best-of-10 warm samples ranged 266ms to 573ms on an unchanged tree), not from what the app can tell apart. Fine per-op regressions are the chrome-free micro-benches' job. One discarded warm-up, then min-of-WEBPERF_RUNS with more samples taken while out of band; the ceiling only ratchets down to a time the run hit TWICE. Baseline scales with graph size — re-accept (deno task bench:accept:web) when scale shifts materially.
